title: Zhu Yuanzhang proclaims the Ming dynasty
summary: The rebel leader Zhu Yuanzhang declared himself emperor in Nanjing, taking the reign name Hongwu and founding the Ming dynasty. His armies took the Yuan capital later that year.
reason: Famine, floods and the Red Turban rebellions had broken the Mongol-led Yuan dynasty, and Zhu had defeated his rival rebel warlords.
significance: It began nearly three centuries of Ming rule, one of the most stable and populous periods in Chinese history.
